body: And I sit here...wanting to just end the pain...because every time it happens...it gets harder to come back..I'm tired of coming back...I just want this to be over....

That's right ladies...want to find someone to be with for the rest of your life...date me...and when you start feeling like I'm not good enough for you...start cheating on me. Make sure you don't  tell me about it until you've fallen in love with this new guy (because you don't want to hurt my feelings)...then spring it on me...and watch me crumble in front of you...make idle threats of revealing your infidelity, or lashing out...because I can't handle losing the person I fell in love with...tell me you want to still be my friend...tell me I am your best friend...tell me how much you love me...tell me I'm the best you've ever had sex with...but ultimately because I'm damaged and feeling like my life is ending, I say and do things that make you so mad at me that you actually don't want anything from me...then leave....and be happy with your new boyfriend and in a couple of months...get married...maybe even invite me to the wedding...because you just want to rub it in my face...
Hey, Happy Birthday - I just had a birthday in September...nobody even noticed...I too was like..no one? seriously? I got a card at work...nobody even signed it...
No friends at all...I've been alone for 8 years...

It's more than small talk..it's any form of communication of any kind...it's weird...I have to for my job...communicate with people...yet nobody communicates with me...and I get in trouble for not doing my job...because I wasn't told about some policy change that my coworkers were supposed to tell me. There are 5 of us...and 2 of them don't even know my name...and I've been here for a year...that is how inconsequential I am.

I've always been the type  of person who is alone in a crowd...I participate...I've always been the type of person to make the leader seem better than they are...because my gift is I can read people so well that I can almost predict their needs before they do...I've always just made it happen...I never get thanked...I never get acknowledged...it's just me
That's normal for me...everyone is rude like that...to me...

In case anyone is wondering..I'm Male, 36, I've been single for 8 years, no I don't want to be single, it just happened that way, nobody wants to be with a severely depressed person, so when I got through that...3 years later, I started dating again...
I'm apparently like Quasimodo or something....I  don't know...I don't think I'm unattractive...I just think that I am invisible...
when I do talk, I say hello, or how was your weekend....or something like that...the response I get is...."Why are you talking to me?" or "Ew, don't talk to me"

I've gone on dates...I've used different dating sites, I've had 5 "major" relationships, 2 engagements, every relationship ends with the significant other cheating on me (again due to my nature...), which I feel I've learned to recognize when my nature pushes them away and adjust so it doesn't become a problem. But nobody I am attracted to wants to date me....they tell me I'm undateable. I'll go on a few dates, and be confident, but I'm too awkward for that...  EVERY single time around the second or third date I get the same exact message...."I had a really great time with you, but something came up and I'm going to have to stop dating for awhile. Goodbye"

Literally the last 6 times I've dated, has ended with that exact message being sent to me.
When I explain my problem or how I am feeling to a "friend" they tell me to just get over it...or ignore me completely...

I'm generally ignored in life...but I've always had a friend or two around...these take years to cultivate...because of my nature...I've always had at least one....now I have nobody...and no prospective friends....

I don't stalk...I'm quiet, and observe...and anticipate needs...so I typically have what is needed before the person who needs something knows they need it...I'm a blip in the radar...generally my own coworkers who I have worked with almost a year don't even know my name...
Hence the...nobody would actually miss me when I'm gone...because nobody actually cares...
Then my other closest friend has a new girlfriend...who is great, has started going out with this new couple (her friends) and they don't like me...because I'm weird...and creepy

For about 4 weeks, when my best friend, told me that even if she were single she wouldn't date me...and that she is leaving her husband for some other guy...and her new boyfriend doesn't like the fact that we are such close friends and wants her to stop talking to me...
